## Overview

**James** is one of the **Four Blood Brothers** — the knights who rose from the crowd at Aegon's trial to stand beside him in the **Judgment of Five**. He was the first to fall in the trial — a lance pierced his thigh, throwing him from his horse.

Despite his injury, he survived and now serves as a commander in the new **Order of the Protectors**. His wound left him with a lasting limp — a constant reminder of the cost of defying the Scales.

---

## Current Status

Separated from Aegon — recovering and coordinating a safehouse network. His injury makes him less mobile, but his strategic mind remains sharp.
